headers.Permissions-Policy: accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()

routes.//: The about and changelog pages link to the scanner as a relative index.html, so they still navigate when opened from disk. On the site that path was served straight off the filesystem, skipping the function and leaving the visit-count placeholder as an inert comment: a visitor who went scanner -> about -> scanner lost the counter. Canonicalising to / fixes that and matches the og:url and canonical tags, which already name / and never /index.html.
